methodology.workload: 60% metrics (~40 B), 30% logs (~200 B) and 10% traces (~500 B), weighted average ~134 B/event after gzip; 60/30/10 signal mix.

definitions.bytes_per_second: Uncompressed protobuf bytes accepted by the receiver divided by the longest shard duration.
definitions.compression_ratio: Raw protobuf bytes divided by wire bytes when transport compression is measurable; otherwise the deterministic payload ratio from the same seed/config. Wire and payload ratios can differ because the workload interleaves signal indices while the payload calibration uses isolated batches. Storage compression (ClickHouse) lands with Story 3.1-3.3.
definitions.confirmed_lost_events: Requires gateway/WAL durability accounting (Stories 4.3-4.5); not collected in Phase 0 throughput runs.
definitions.cpu_percent: Machine-wide CPU busy percentage sampled once per second; 100 means all CPUs busy.
definitions.disk_bytes: Filesystem total and free bytes on the result path, sampled once per second.
definitions.dropped_events: Failed plus rejected events reported by the load generator.
definitions.error_rate: Failed plus rejected events divided by generated events.
definitions.events_per_second: Events generated divided by the longest load generator shard duration (runner aggregate).
definitions.ingest_lag_ms: Time between the event timestamp and the durable write. Requires gateway/WAL metrics (Story 4.3); not collected in Phase 0 throughput runs.
definitions.query_latency_ms: Query Service latency for the 20-query dashboard set. Requires the Query Service (Story 3.5).
definitions.ram_bytes: Machine memory in use (MemTotal minus MemAvailable), sampled once per second.
definitions.send_latency_ms: OTLP export request latency measured by the load generator; with multiple shards the report keeps the worst shard's p50/p95/p99.

variance.note: ADR-0006 allows one continuous 1h gate run; with fewer than two runs the variance is not assessed.

repetitions: Latency and error-rate comparisons need at least 3 runs (ADR-0006 rule 10); the report states when the minimum is not met.
A 1h throughput gate run may be a single continuous execution when stability metrics (backpressure, pacing lag, resource samples) are published.
Variance is only assessed for runs with the same scenario and config hash. Runs spanning commits are listed but not judged as reruns.
Every run is listed, including failed and blocked ones; comparisons use only status=ok, mode=run runs.
limitations: Ingest lag p50/p95/p99 and confirmed lost events require the gateway/WAL (Stories 4.3-4.5); Phase 0 throughput runs report generator send latency instead and mark those metrics not collected.
Query and cardinality latency require the Query Service and the series generator (Stories 3.4-3.5); their scenarios are reported as plans/blocked until then.
ClickHouse/VictoriaMetrics storage compression is not measured here; compression_ratio is the wire or deterministic payload ratio, labelled by source.
Resource sampling is host-level on Linux; other platforms report the metrics as unavailable.
Pricing assumptions are an open founder decision (ADR-0006 Q-07); the report publishes the volume inputs, not a TCO verdict.

scenario.name: throughput-100k
scenario.title: Throughput 100k events/s
scenario.description: Sustained reference workload at 100k events/s for 1 hour, the design-partner tier.
scenario.hardware: 1 loadgen host (8 vCPU, 16 GB); single-node backend (8 vCPU, 32 GB, local NVMe); 1 Gbps network.
scenario.expected: Timestamped folder with one loadgen summary and log; achieved rate within ±5% of 100k/s; zero failed or rejected events; pipeline lag p95 below 10s and zero confirmed events lost.
